issues.description: Script uses fetch and GM_xmlhttpRequest to communicate with api-router.nexusmods.com and www.nexusmods.com. All requests are to official Nexus Mods endpoints and do not transmit user data beyond what is required for mod download functionality.
issues.recommendation: Ensure only necessary data is sent and no sensitive user information is included in requests.

issues.description: Script requests multiple @grant permissions (GM.xmlHttpRequest, GM_xmlhttpRequest, GM_setValue, GM_getValue, GM.setValue, GM.getValue, GM_addStyle), but only uses GM_xmlhttpRequest, GM.getValue, GM.setValue, and GM_addStyle in the code.
issues.recommendation: Remove unused permissions (@grant GM.xmlHttpRequest, GM_setValue, GM_getValue) to minimize attack surface.

issues.description: Script uses fetch with credentials: 'include', which may transmit cookies to Nexus Mods endpoints.
issues.recommendation: Ensure cookies are only sent to trusted domains and not to third parties.

summary: 该脚本仅与 Nexus Mods 官方 API 和页面进行通信，不存在隐私采集、远程代码执行、代码混淆或 DOM XSS 风险。主要风险为数据外传（仅限官方域名）、权限滥用（申请未使用的高权限）和敏感 API（cookie 传递）。整体风险为中等，建议移除未使用权限并持续关注官方 API 的安全性。
